# idjo Extensions

Signed [Aniyomi](https://github.com/aniyomiorg/aniyomi) extensions. They work in Aniyomi and its forks, such as [Anikku](https://github.com/komikku-app/anikku).

This repository only holds built APKs and the repository index. CI regenerates it on every push to the source repository.

## Usage

In the app, open **More** -> **Settings** -> **Browse** -> **Anime extension repos**, tap **Add**, and paste:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idjoo/extensions/repo/index.min.json
```

Then refresh the **Extensions** tab.

Or open https://idjoo.github.io/add-repo-ani on your phone to add it in one tap. https://idjoo.github.io/extensions-aniyomi/ lists every extension with a direct APK download.
